{P : Type} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup P] →
    [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ P] →
      {Label : Type} →
        {s : NavierStokes.WeightedClasses.StripData (P × NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Plane)} →
          {α : ℝ} →
            {d : Label → ℕ → NavierStokes.PrimaryODE.FrameData (P × ℝ)} →
              {t : Label → ℕ → NavierStokes.CommonCoverSolve.TangentData P NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space} →
                {harmonic : ℤ} →
                  {g : Label → ℕ → NavierStokes.CommonCoverSolve.Geometry} →
                    {L : Label → ℕ → ℝ} →
                      {envelope : Label → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} →
                        {cells :
                            Label →
                              ℕ → NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Frequency → Set (P × NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Plane)} →
                          (neighborhood :
                              Label →
                                ℕ → NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Frequency → Set (P × NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Plane)) →
                            (∀ (l : Label) (n : ℕ) (k : NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Frequency),
                                IsOpen (neighborhood l n k)) →
                              (∀ (l : Label) (n : ℕ) (k : NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Frequency),
                                  ∀ x ∈ s.domain, x ∈ cells l n k → x ∈ neighborhood l n k) →
                                (interval : Label → ℕ → Set ℝ) →
                                  (∀ (l : Label) (n : ℕ), IsOpen (interval l n)) →
                                    (∀ (l : Label) (n : ℕ), 0 < L l n) →
                                      (∀ (l : Label) (n : ℕ), Set.Icc 0 (L l n) ⊆ interval l n) →
                                        (∀ (l : Label) (n : ℕ) (k : NavierStokes.PrimaryCopyBridge.Frequency),
                                            NavierStokes.PrimaryCopyBridge.Inputs (d l n) (t l n) harmonic (g l n) k
                                              (neighborhood l n k) 0 (L l n)) →
                                          (∀ (l : Label) (n : ℕ) (k : NavierStokes.PrimaryCopyBridge.Frequency),
                                              ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤)
                                                ((NavierStokes.PrimaryCopyBridge.copyFrame (d l n) (g l n)
                                                      k).coefficient
                                                  harmonic)
                                                (neighborhood l n k ×ˢ interval l n)) →
                                            (∀ (l : Label) (n : ℕ) (k : NavierStokes.PrimaryCopyBridge.Frequency),
                                                ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤)
                                                  ((NavierStokes.PrimaryCopyBridge.copyFrame (d l n) (g l n) k).forcing
                                                    (NavierStokes.PrimaryCopyBridge.copySource (t l n).source (g l n)
                                                      k))
                                                  (neighborhood l n k ×ˢ interval l n)) →
                                              (∀ (l : Label) (n : ℕ) (k : NavierStokes.PrimaryCopyBridge.Frequency)
                                                  (i : Fin 2),
                                                  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤)
                                                    (NavierStokes.PrimaryPulseBounds.synthesisColumn
                                                      (NavierStokes.PrimaryCopyBridge.copyFrame (d l n) (g l n) k) i)
                                                    (neighborhood l n k ×ˢ interval l n)) →
                                                (∀ (l : Label) (n : ℕ) (k : NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Frequency),
                                                    ∀ x ∈ neighborhood l n k,
                                                      ((g l n).coordinates k x.2).2 ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (L l n)) →
                                                  (rate : Label → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) →
                                                    (∀ (l : Label) (n : ℕ) (v : ℝ), 0 < envelope l n v) →
                                                      (∀ (l : Label) (n : ℕ) (v : ℝ),
                                                          HasDerivAt (envelope l n) (rate l n v * envelope l n v) v) →
                                                        (errorRate : Label → ℕ → ℝ) →
                                                          (∀ (l : Label) (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ errorRate l n) →
                                                            (constant : ℝ) →
                                                              1 ≤ constant →
                                                                (coordinate_power : ℕ) →
                                                                  (∀ (l : Label) (n : ℕ), L l n ≤ constant * s.slow n) →
                                                                    (∀ (l : Label) (n : ℕ),
                                                                        Real.exp (errorRate l n * L l n) ≤ constant) →
                                                                      (∀ (l : Label) (n : ℕ),
                                                                          NavierStokes.CommonCoverClass.argumentCost
                                                                              (g l n) ≤
                                                                            constant * s.slow n ^ coordinate_power) →
                                                                        (∀ (l : Label) (n : ℕ)
                                                                            (k : NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Frequency),
                                                                            ∀ x ∈ s.domain,
                                                                              x ∈ cells l n k →
                                                                                ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 (L l n),
                                                                                  ∀ (z : NavierStokes.PrimaryODE.State),
                                                                                    inner ℝ z
                                                                                        (((NavierStokes.PrimaryCopyBridge.copyFrame
                                                                                                (d l n) (g l n)
                                                                                                k).coefficient
                                                                                            harmonic (x, v))
                                                                                          z) ≤
                                                                                      (rate l n v + errorRate l n) *
                                                                                        ‖z‖ ^ 2) →
                                                                          (∀ (N : ℕ),
                                                                              ∃ (C : ℝ),
                                                                                0 ≤ C ∧
                                                                                  ∃ (m : ℕ),
                                                                                    ∀ (l : Label) (n : ℕ)
                                                                                      (k :
                                                                                        NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Frequency),
                                                                                      ∀ x ∈ s.domain,
                                                                                        x ∈ cells l n k →
                                                                                          ∀ j ≤ N, ∀ (v : ℝ), ⋯) →
                                                                            NavierStokes.ParticularCopyBounds.UniformModalControl
                                                                              s α d t harmonic g L envelope cells
